description: THE conversion verb: fire one canonical conversion event to every configured ad platform at once (fan-out + dedup). Pass raw identity — adscapi hashes per platform. More match keys → higher match rate → lower CAC.

clickIds.description: Captured click ids, e.g. { fbclid, gclid, ttclid }.

event.description: Canonical event name, e.g. purchase, lead, signup.

eventId.description: Stable id for cross-pixel/CAPI dedup (auto-derived if omitted).

value.description: Conversion value (send predicted LTV for value-based bidding).

name: adscapi_fire_conversion
